description: Machine-readable provider-route metadata for the contact-brief Agent Plugin. Every route is email-only enrichment of one already identity-resolved person, or mailbox verification of one approved address. Human-readable rules live in SKILL.md, references/providers.md and README.md; this file is the metadata those rules are checked against.

batchBridge.packageRole: imports one normalized result per person; never discovers replacement people
requirements: fixed user-approved identity list frozen before paid enrichment
stable person correlation and one result per person
aggregate spend ceiling and per-item attempt visibility
no automatic write into Contact Brief or Jobsss state

codex_exa_plugin.label: Codex Exa plugin handoff
codex_exa_plugin.purpose: one email-only lookup for an already identity-resolved person through a callable host Exa tool
inputs: at most one attributable professional address

approval.note: no key is managed by this package; the host must show a callable Exa tool and the agent must not substitute a paid route silently

codex_exa_plugin.importer: python3 scripts/contact_brief.py import-exa request.json --result private/exa-plugin-result.json --out private/request-with-email.json

exa_agent_fiber.label: Exa Agent with the Fiber data source
exa_agent_fiber.purpose: one email-only Exa Agent run with dataSources [{"provider": "fiber"}] for an already identity-resolved person
inputs: at most one attributable professional address
run metadata: run_id, retrieved_at, usage, cost, attribution

limits.budgetParameter: never omitted when the provider route accepts one

approval.note: the host owns the credential, the run request and the spend ceiling; this package never calls Fiber and never reads a provider key

spend.note: record the returned cost/usage objects and the scalar total; do not treat local estimates as provider-enforced caps

exa_agent_fiber.importer: python3 scripts/contact_brief.py import-fiber request.json --result private/fiber-agent-result.json --out private/request-with-email.json

evidence.sourceUrls: may legitimately be empty for provider_reported; an empty list never makes the address source_supported

direct_exa_agent_api.label: Direct Exa Agent API fallback (bundled helper)
direct_exa_agent_api.purpose: legacy single-person fallback used only when no callable host Exa tool exists, after explicit authorization
direct_exa_agent_api.request: POST /agent/runs whose body carries query, one input data row for the approved person, dataSources [{"provider": "fiber"}], effort low and the email-only outputSchema; then bounded GET /agent/runs/{id} polling. The body is journaled verbatim and reused as the resume fingerprint.

approval.artifact: private authorization JSON with approved=true, exact name, exact company and max_total_usd
approval.note: reserved allowance is a local dispatch gate, not a provider-enforced hard cap

spend.journal: required persistent journal prevents blind duplicate dispatch

direct_exa_agent_api.normalization: the host normalizes the direct run into the fiber envelope before importing, so briefLookupProvider is exa_agent_fiber
direct_exa_agent_api.importer: python3 scripts/contact_brief.py import-fiber request.json --result private/fiber-agent-result.json --out private/request-with-email.json

aftership_mailbox_check.label: AfterShip mailbox verification (optional adapter)
aftership_mailbox_check.purpose: separately authorized syntax/DNS/SMTP check of one already discovered address; never a discovery route and never identity proof
inputs: authorization JSON fields for the requested check depth

limits.smtp: requires separate authorization and the --smtp flag

approval.note: without an authorized run the mailbox stays not_checked

evidence.sourceUrls: not applicable; a mailbox result is not an attribution source
evidence.mailbox: status, method and checked_at are recorded; DNS is never relabelled as SMTP
